title: A1 German Verbs Grouped for Easy Learning
purpose: Learn verbs by conjugation pattern instead of memorising 115 unrelated tables.

regular_example.why: The stem komm- stays the same. Add the normal endings: -e, -st, -t, -en, -t, -en.

stem_changing_example.why: The stem vowel changes from e to i in du and er/sie/es. Learn these forms specially.

recommended_learning_order: 1. Memorize sein, haben, werden and wissen.
2. Learn the regular endings once; then practise regular verbs as a group.
3. Learn stem-changing verbs, especially the du and er/sie/es forms.
5. Learn separable verbs and put the prefix at the end of a main clause.
6. Learn reflexive verbs with their pronouns (mich, dich, sich, uns, euch, sich).
7. Review spelling/pronunciation adjustments such as arbeiten → du arbeitest.
